headings.usage: H1, H2, Certificate Titles, Main Marketing copy

body.usage: Paragraphs, Buttons, Labels, UI Elements, Chat Bubbles

mono.usage: SHA-256 Hashes, Timestamps, Block Numbers, Verification details
mono.styling: tracking-wider text-xs or text-sm uppercase text-muted

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Avoid muddy shadows. Use subtle shadow-sm for cards or crisp 1px borders (border-black/10).
visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-[#D5D2CA] to create crisp 'document-like' grid lines. Square edges or small rounded-md (4px). No fully rounded pills.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply subtle SVG noise over the landing page background to reduce digital flatness.

components.Certificate: The star component. Must look like a physical notary document. Pure white background, thin graphite borders, Cormorant Garamond for titles, IBM Plex Mono for hashes. Include a large prominent SVG seal in Seal Green (#1F5940). Add 'Verificado' typography in serif.
components.Chat_Thread: Private chat should feel secure and restricted. Use standard rectangular bubbles with 4px border-radius. Graphite background with Bone White text for 'me', and Surface Secondary background with Graphite text for 'them'. Include timestamp in mono font.
components.Status_Badge: Pendiente: monochrome outline with gray text. Confirmado: solid Seal Green background with bone white text.
components.Dropzone: Dashed graphite border (border-dashed border-[#D5D2CA] bg-[#F8F7F4]). When hovering to upload/verify, border changes to Seal Green.
components.Verification_Result: Success: Giant Seal Green checkmark and Seal Green borders. Error: Red (#8B2626) cross and text 'Hash no coincide'.

grids_and_spacing.system: Use extremely generous spacing to emphasize premium feel. Use p-8 or p-12 for main cards. gap-8 to gap-12 between sections.
grids_and_spacing.bento_grid: For the dashboard, use strict CSS grid. Main agreements list spans more columns, stats/profile spans fewer columns.

layouts.landing: Mobile-first flex column. Desktop: Asymmetrical 2-column layout. Huge left-aligned typography. Right side: 3D or tilt-effect visual of a verified certificate.
layouts.certificate_page: Centered narrow container (max-w-3xl) to mimic a physical A4 paper aspect ratio, floating above the background.
layouts.agreement_view: Desktop: Split screen. Left side: The document/text content (max-w-2xl). Right side: The private chat thread (sticky, side panel).

motion_and_interactions.seal_animation: When an agreement goes to 'Confirmado', animate the green seal: scale down from 2x and stamp onto the document with a subtle framer-motion spring/bounce.
motion_and_interactions.hash_calculation: While calculating SHA-256 in browser, scramble random alphanumeric characters in mono font rapidly for 0.5s before showing the final hash.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Buttons scale down to 0.98 on click. Hover states on buttons shift background slightly darker.

accessibility.contrast: Graphite on Bone White easily passes APCA. Seal Green on Bone White also passes.
accessibility.focus: Use ring-2 ring-[#1F5940] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#F8F7F4] for focus states.
accessibility.test_ids: Every CTA, input, form, and hash display MUST have a data-testid attribute.

landing_hero.description: Wax stamp on document for abstract premium feel on landing

icons_strategy: lucide-react. Use 1.5px stroke width (strokeWidth={1.5}) for a premium, delicate, precise look. Do not use solid/filled icons except for the green checkmark.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align app container globally.
Mobile-first implies standard stacking (flex-col) defaulting to md:flex-row or grid where necessary.
STRICTLY adhere to the monochromatic palette with the ONE accent color (Seal Green / #1F5940). Avoid default Vercel/Stripe styles. NO neon, NO generic blue.
CRITICAL: Use the custom typography. Import Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, and IBM Plex Mono in the global CSS or root.
For the crypto hashing, implement crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', ...) securely in the frontend. Do NOT send unhashed files to the server.
To display pending status, make sure it says 'Pendiente de confirmación' without any Bitcoin block numbers yet.
For verified status, clearly say 'Confirmado en bloque Bitcoin #N'.
Ensure the UI is in Spanish as requested.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all interactive components to allow UI testing.
Avoid fully transparent headers with no backdrop-blur if content scrolls underneath.
The Certificate layout should visually prioritize the generated Hash and the 'Seal Green' stamp to look official.
